Class RegistreContracteDaoImpl

java.lang.Object
es.uji.ei1027.ei102725gbgs.dao.RegistreContracteDaoImpl
@Repository public class RegistreContracteDaoImpl extends Object
Data Access Object implementation for RegistreContracte entities.

Provides JDBC-based persistence operations for contract records linked to assistant selections. The primary key type is Integer.
